content.text:
The drawing shows a phenoxy-substituted benzamide carrying a Boc-protected aminobutyl chain, read region by region as follows.

- **Left ring:** a phenyl ring joined through an ether oxygen to the central benzene ring.
- **Central ring:** a benzene ring with the phenoxy group at C4, OMe at C2, and the carbonyl at C1.
- **Amide and chain:** the C(=O)NH group leads into a chain of four CH2 groups. Counting the vertices from the amide N, the chain runs N, CH2, CH2, CH2, CH2, then the NH of the Boc group, so it is a butyl chain.
- **Protecting group:** the terminal NH carries Boc, which is C(=O)OC(C)(C)C.

SMILES: COc1cc(Oc2ccccc2)ccc1C(=O)NCCCCNC(=O)OC(C)(C)C
